[NADP.3.3] **No-op reassertion is the engine's job
(LFAC.2.5.1).** The adapter is encouraged to re-emit
on every source change without filtering — the
engine dedups exact-and-tolerance equal reassertions.
Adapters that suppress at the source (comparing against
last-emitted state) make fewer calls into the engine at the
cost of slightly more code; engine-side dedup is the
correctness contract.
